China Telecom's Profit Declined in First Nine Months of 2026
China Telecom posted a lower profit for the nine months ended September, weighed by adjustments linked to value-added tax.
Net profit for the first three quarters dropped 15% to 26.21 billion yuan, equivalent to US$3.93 billion, compared with the same period a year earlier, the telecommunications company said Thursday.
China Telecom said earnings would have maintained favorable growth excluding the adjustment to the scope of value-added tax classification applied to items in the nine months under review.
The company's nine-month operating revenue was 382.40 billion yuan, declining 3.7% on year.
Hong Kong-listed shares of China Telecom last closed 1.9% lower at 4.365 Hong Kong dollars, equivalent to 56 U.S. cents, bringing its year-to-date losses to 19%.
